CustomField.formula:
TRIM( BLANKVALUE(Current_Address__Street__s, "") & IF(ISBLANK(Current_Address__Street__s), "", ", ") &
BLANKVALUE(Current_Address__City__s, "") & IF(ISBLANK(Current_Address__City__s), "", ", ") &
TEXT(Current_Address__StateCode__s) & IF( AND( NOT(ISBLANK(TEXT(Current_Address__StateCode__s))), NOT(ISBLANK(Current_Address__PostalCode__s)) ), " ", "" ) &
BLANKVALUE(Current_Address__PostalCode__s, "") )
CustomField.label: Complete Address
